title: Exact Koszul completion and the triangulated complete locus
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site with a sheaf of commutative rings $\mathcal O$ and a finite list of global sections $b_1,\ldots,b_r$, possibly empty. Put $\mathcal J=(b_1,\ldots,b_r)\mathcal O$ and use $D(\mathcal O)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $Q_m=\bigotimes_j[\mathcal O\xrightarrow{b_j^m}\mathcal O]$ in degrees $[-r,0]$, with transition $b_j$ in degree $-1$ and identity in degree $0$ in each factor, and use the natural degree-zero augmentation unit $\eta_N:N\to\Lambda(N)=R\lim_m(N\otimes^L Q_m)$ of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-completion-reflector], with the strict-tower derived limit of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. Then $\Lambda$ is an exact functor of triangulated categories and the unit commutes with shifts and maps of distinguished triangles. The locally derived $\mathcal J$-complete objects [def-weil-pbc-locally-derived-ringed-ideal-complete] form a strictly full triangulated subcategory [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory]: zero is complete; isomorphisms and all integer shifts preserve completeness; and in every distinguished triangle completeness of two vertices implies completeness of the third. No Noetherian or boundedness hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tag 0A0E (lemma-derived-completion-koszul) and Tag 099B (lemma-derived-completion); Tag 0999 (definition-derived-complete), paragraph immediately after the definition.

proof.text: For every slice U and every local section f, let H(U,f) be derived internal Hom from the localization O_U[f^-1] in degree zero. Its varying second argument has a coherent integer-shift structure and is triangulated by ringedInternalHom_exact, the original small-site interface publicly retained by the independent-universe internal-Hom module [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction]. Compose it with ringedDerivedRestriction O U, the exact-functor derived localization of slice module restriction [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction]. These are exact functors G(U,f) on the unbounded derived category.

source.place: Tags 08JB and 08JC: restriction and exactness of derived internal Hom.

proof.text: The actual local-completeness predicate [def-weil-pbc-locally-derived-ringed-ideal-complete] says that G(U,f)(N) is zero for every U and every section f in the image of the ideal mono. Isomorphisms preserve this vanishing. Each G(U,f) sends zero to zero; its integer-shift comparison identifies the image of N[n] with the shift of its image. For a distinguished triangle, apply G(U,f); zero first and third vertices imply zero middle vertex by the zero-object criterion for distinguished triangles. These explicit arguments give isomorphism closure, a zero object, stability under all integer shifts, and extension closure, exactly the strictly full triangulated-subcategory condition [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory]. Rotation supplies both other two-out-of-three cases. No finite-generation or boundedness hypothesis is used in this step.

source.place: Tag 0999, definition-derived-complete and the following paragraph.

proof.text: Apply ringedKoszulCompletionReflector O r b I iota hgen, the original general ringed-site interface retained by [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-completion-reflector], to obtain D with complete outputs, the Hom bijections by precomposition with D.unit, and naturality of D.unit. This is the actual strict Koszul presentation, including its transitions and total derived inverse limit, not a newly chosen replacement. Assemble eta with components D.unit. Lift D.completion to the full subcategory on the local predicate. Compose the inclusion hom equivalence with the reflector Hom bijection to construct an adjunction from this lift to inclusion. Left naturality uses eta.naturality and injectivity of the bijection; right naturality is associativity. Applying the Hom equivalence to identity proves that this adjunction unit equals eta.

The full-subcategory inclusion has the triangulated structure supplied by Step 2. Give its left adjoint the shift structure Adjunction.leftAdjointCommShift and use commShift_of_rightAdjoint, the left-adjoint dual of the compatible-adjoint shift construction [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-shift-compatibility-unique]. Apply Mathlib Adjunction.isTriangulated_leftAdjoint, the opposite-category dual of [lem-sf-triangulated-right-adjoint]. Thus the lift is triangulated. Compose it with the triangulated inclusion. Transport this composite shift and exactness through ObjectProperty.liftCompIotaIso (Lean: liftCompιIso). Transport the shift-compatible adjunction unit along that same comparison. The equality of Step 3 identifies its components with D.unit exactly, giving NatTrans.CommShift of the requested eta. The private exact_reflector helper carries out this generic argument with no postponed proof. The case of an empty generating list is included because only the reflector existence hypothesis uses that list.

source.place: Section Adjoints for exact functors, lemma-adjoint-is-exact, applied to opposite categories for the left-adjoint form. Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Triangulated.Adjunction isTriangulated_leftAdjoint and Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Shift.Adjunction leftAdjointCommShift implement this directly.
